test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Five bells begin to toll together and toll at intervals of 4, 6, 7, 8 and 12 seconds, respectively. After how many seconds, will they toll together again?
solution:
**Given:**

Five bells begin to toll together and toll at intervals of 4, 6, 7, 8 and 12 seconds, respectively.

**Concept used:**

Lowest common multiple

**Calculation:**

The three bells will toll together again when the time is equal to the LCM of 4, 6, 7, 8 and 12.

The LCM of 4, 6, 7, 8 and 12 is 168.

**∴ The three bells will toll together again in 168 seconds. **
